subject: Heres another off roader for ya

body:

This is a game called Baja, Edge of Control. A lot more realistic than Pure and Motor Storm, with 3 to 4 hours of racing, though you can let the computer race for you as it learns your driving skills, LOL. For Ps3 and XBox 360.

subject: Got to say this is...
author: SUFFUR
body:
An excellent game going by the demo, and has great  boost jumping potential, not like Revenge, but you have to do stuff before, during and after a jump to get boost(hit the X button).

48 tracks, 100,000 customizable bits for your quad, short crash times, a character that falls off when you crash and holds on for dear life when boosting, looks good, and 16 people on line, nice.

And I'll miss it's release due to being in Singapore, Boo!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Its got the burnoutishness about it
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Yeah Psyche,   agreed, its got alot of potential.  Good sense of speed and the mechanic of that risk/reward for tricking over jumps for more boost versus just holding the gas and steering.  Its got alot of the finesse jumping in it alot like the boost jumps on burnout.  I'm pickin it up for sure.

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!
